title: AUTHORIZE the Chief Executive Officer to: A. EXECUTE Modification No. 14 to Contract No. PS66773HRT with Sepulveda Transit Corridor Partners, LLC (STCP) to…
text:
[Metro Board file 2026-0754, Contract]
[EXECUTIVE MANAGEMENT COMMITTEE MADE THE FOLLOWING RECOMMENDATION (3-0):]
AUTHORIZE the Chief Executive Officer to:

A.	EXECUTE Modification No. 14 to Contract No. PS66773HRT with Sepulveda Transit Corridor Partners, LLC (STCP) to provide additional technical services in the amount of $29,645,334.25 for design and project development to advance the approved Sepulveda Transit Corridor Locally Preferred Alternative (LPA), increasing the contract value from $87,353,033.75 to $116,998,368;

B.	AUTHORIZE additional Contract Modification Authority (CMA) for Contract No. PS66773HRT in the amount of $2,964,533.43 and authorize the CEO to execute individual Contract Modifications within the Board-approved CMA; and 

C.	AMEND the adopted FY27 budget to increase non-labor funding for Project #460305 by $26,500,000 from $59,023,199 to $85,523,199.
summary: Metro would pay Sepulveda Transit Corridor Partners about $29.6 million more for design work on the Sepulveda transit line, raising that contract to roughly $117 million. The board would also add $26.5 million to the project's budget.
